documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for To Consider Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported its highest-ever sales, EBITDA, profit before tax, and PAT for the first quarter of FY27, driven by robust demand across segments and operational efficiencies. Management highlighted ongoing export opportunities in North America and Africa, alongside potential railway braking business following the upcoming commissioning of a dynamometer. The company expects to sustain its growth momentum backed by strong customer relationships and a healthy order pipeline, while funding capital expenditures through internal accruals. Menon Bearings Limited reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue from operations of Rs. 94.04 crore in Q1FY27, marking a 37.2% YoY growth, along with a highest-ever EBITDA of Rs.

guidance.claim: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: In the brakes segment, management expects a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year, going up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within the next two years.
guidance.quote: and with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

guidance.claim: For the Alkop business, the company targets INR100 crores this year and around INR125 crores next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The share of electric vehicles in the Alkop business is targeted to reach 8% to 10% by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: that in the Alkop business, the share of EV by FY27 end can be in the range of 8% to 10%.

guidance.claim: Export revenue is expected to increase up to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: Management targets a conservative growth of 20% plus year-on-year.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: Management targets overall turnover growth at a rate of 25% year-on-year for the next few years.
guidance.quote: And again, we will be sustaining this because of increase in the overall turnover which we are targeting at a rate of 25% year-on-year for next few years.

guidance.claim: Management is aiming to reach INR 500 crores in revenue by 2028.
guidance.quote: And we will take all-out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28.

guidance.claim: Management estimates total revenues to exceed INR 360 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: Precisely, what we have estimated is more than INR 360 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain EBITDA margins between 20% and 22% during the next two years.
guidance.quote: I again assure you that considering the present situation going forward, we will be able to maintain EBITDA more than 20% and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to experience sustained demand in its primary segment of auto components.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to operate within our primary segment of auto components where we are seeing sustained demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports to the USA market increased by almost 50% over the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: So far as USA market is concerned, our exports have gone up by almost 50% over last year so far as USA market is concerned and there is a lot of opportunities we are looking for.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports account for around 35% of overall sales, with roughly 80% of exports directed to Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: Today, out of the whole pie chart, we are doing around 35%. Out of 100, we are doing export and around 80% of export goes to Europe, but now we are seeing a lot of European demand and European inquiries coming.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores this financial year for increasing bi-metal capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned a CapEx of around INR4 crores for this year in Alkop alone.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is under construction and expected by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

capex_expansion.claim: In the Brakes division, ₹0.58 crore capex was fully deployed in FY26 with an additional ₹2.50 crore planned over the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: Planned CapEx is INR 7 crores for the Alkop division and INR 3 crores for the brake division.
capex_expansion.quote: And for Alkop, it is INR7 crores and brakes, it is INR3 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The brake division expects to receive a new testing machine/dynamometer by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: That is under production and we will be receiving it by the end of August and thereafter we will take up the business not only of railways but OEMs business also will be in our fold, I am sure.

margins_costs.claim: For the first quarter, EBITDA margin in the brakes segment reached 25%.
margins_costs.quote: now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, margins are expected to be sustained around 20% to 21% over a period of time.
margins_costs.quote: overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: Consumable costs such as carbide tools for automobile manufacturers have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Copper raw material prices have been volatile, increasing from INR 1,210 to INR 1,275 recently.
margins_costs.quote: Last month it was INR 1,210, now it has risen to INR 1,275. So it is fluctuating according to the geopolitical situation and market. So, they are very volatile.

margins_costs.claim: Increased capacity utilization lowers per-unit production costs as fixed costs stay constant while productivity rises.
margins_costs.quote: What happens, when the production capacity utilization goes up, the productivity increase. The expenses related variable expenses to some extent increase, but the fixed cost remain the same.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a current order book of more than INR 32 crores, expecting to serve between INR 30 crores to INR 31 crores on a consolidated basis.
orders_capacity.quote: You see, our current order position is more than INR32 crores. Out of that, we'll be serving almost more than between INR30 crores to INR31 crores on a consolidated basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The new development parts pipeline in the aluminium business comprises 51 new parts worth almost INR 30 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new development parts pipeline is robust with 51 new parts across major customers like John Deere for India domestic and exports as well. Eaton, Taco Prestolite and Mayekawa representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Bi-Metal division has a new development business pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With this, apart from this, in Bi-Metal division also, we are having a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Alkop's capacity utilization is currently 65% and is expected to reach 90% by the end of the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Utilization as of now is 65% and it is likely to go up to 90% by the end of this year so that we will have to engage another furnace next year.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in the Bi-Metal division has reached up to 85%.
orders_capacity.quote: Now we are up to the production targets and capacity utilization to the extent of 85% in Bi-Metal.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded entirely through internal accruals without taking any fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a dividend of Rs. 2 per share on equity shares of face value Re. 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Note: The Board has declared Dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck over a prior three-month period due to backlogs caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Company forward-looking statements are subject to risks including the performance of Indian and international economies, industry competition, and operational factors.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade receivables turnaround time for US exports exceeds 180 days, impacting working capital and interest expense.
risks_headwinds.quote: You see, since we have started the business and our exports have gone up, particularly in USA, the total turnaround time of debtors is more than 180 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: War and geopolitical conflicts have extended shipping times along export logistics routes.
risks_headwinds.quote: But there are some logistic issues now because of the war, logistic lines are taking a little longer.

risks_headwinds.claim: Congestion in Dubai and Middle East ports delayed export shipments to South Africa.
risks_headwinds.quote: Before it went three times a month, is going once a month, because of congestion in the Dubai ports and Middle East ports.
